document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You cross the landscape of the lost world, little thinking of the 
hollow fame that will be yours if you can report it to civilization. 
Grief is your constant companion and the regret of your failure 
as a leader. You finally find the way out of the lost valley and 
leave it behind.
